precedents.subject: CSV export slow or failing
precedents.body: Exporting a large report to CSV takes forever or fails.
precedents.answer: Open the dashboard and choose Export > CSV. Large reports are prepared in the background and sent as a download link when ready.

precedents.subject: Password reset email missing
precedents.body: I requested a password reset but the email never arrives.
precedents.answer: Check your spam or junk folder first. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes. If it expired, request a new link from the login page.

precedents.subject: CSV-Export langsam
precedents.body: Der Export eines großen Berichts dauert sehr lange.
precedents.answer: Öffnen Sie das Dashboard und wählen Sie Export > CSV. Große Berichte werden im Hintergrund erstellt und als Download-Link bereitgestellt.

precedents.subject: CSV export slow or failing
precedents.body: Exporting a large report to CSV takes forever or fails.
precedents.answer: Open the dashboard and choose Export > CSV. Large reports are prepared in the background and sent as a download link when ready.

subject: Password reset email
body: I asked for a password reset but the email never arrived. Can you help?

precedents.subject: Password reset email missing
precedents.body: I requested a password reset but the email never arrives.
precedents.answer: Check your spam or junk folder first. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes. If it expired, request a new link from the login page.

precedents.subject: Account locked
precedents.body: My account is locked after several login attempts.
precedents.answer: The account locks after 5 failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes, or use 'Forgot password' on the login page to unlock it.

subject: Passwort-Reset

subject: Update card
body: How do I update the credit card on our account? The old one expires next month.

precedents.subject: Change payment card
precedents.body: How do I change the card we pay with?
precedents.answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Payment method and choose Update card. The new card is used from the next invoice.

precedents.subject: Charged twice
precedents.body: We were charged twice for the same month.
precedents.answer: Billing reviews duplicate charges and corrects them on the next invoice. Please send the invoice number so the team can check it.

subject: Print job
body: How do I cancel a print job that is stuck in the queue?

precedents.subject: Stuck print job
precedents.body: A print job is stuck in the queue.
precedents.answer: Open Settings > Printers, select the printer, open the queue, select the job and choose Cancel. Then restart the print spooler.

precedents.subject: Printer offline
precedents.body: The office printer shows as offline.
precedents.answer: Restart the printer and check that it still has its fixed IP address in the printer's network settings. Then re-add it on the laptop.
